info.title: remo-code hub
info.description: REST API for the remo-code hub. Routes are migrated to the OpenAPI surface incrementally; currently covers `/api/profile/cost-today` and `/api/profile/license`. The rest of the hub is plain Hono.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's real accumulated token spend so far today (the same figure the daily cost cap enforces — interactive, Telegram, webhook and scheduled-run turns), their configured daily cap, and percent consumed. Used by the cost-cap UI banner.

200.description: Cost snapshot for the current calendar day in the user's timezone

get.summary: License status for the authenticated user
get.description: Returns the user's current license status (mirrored from Titanium Licensing), license id, and the timestamp of the last sync. Used by the web UI's license badge. Auth-gated; NOT license-gated — needed even when the license is expired so the user can see why.

get.summary: List local folders awaiting GitHub classification
get.description: Returns folders the user's agent/supervisor has reported as not-yet-on-GitHub (or not a git repo at all) and that the user has NOT dismissed. Drives the 'Needs attention' section of the sidebar. See Phase 08 ARCHITECTURE §6.

200.description: Pending local repos for the authenticated user

post.description: Records a user dismissal for `(hostname, project_dir)` and removes the row from `pending_local_repos`. Idempotent — repeated calls return 200 without duplicating dismissals.

get.summary: List the user's repo groups with members

post.summary: Add a repo to a group (idempotent)

put.summary: Replace a group's full member set

delete.summary: Remove a repo from a group (repo_ident URL-encoded)

get.summary: Get a session's orchestrator task + its rows (task null if none)

post.summary: Create the one orchestrator task for a session

409.description: Session already has an orchestrator task

patch.summary: Update the task's lifecycle stage and/or macro task type

post.summary: Apply a lifecycle-stage frequency preset to the rows
Add a command row or a micro-prompt row

patch.summary: Update a row (enabled / frequency / schedule_rule / micro_prompt / sort_order)

post.summary: Bulk-reorder a task's rows by id

get.description: Returns the static, read-only catalog of GSD task templates (Run dev, Audit, Review PRs, Plan). A template pre-fills a normal scheduled-task CREATE — it is sugar over the existing payload (no new table). Each carries an injected GSD slash prompt, default cadence, guardrails (non-bypassable cost cap, plan-first), and default post-run actions.
